Image 2 supplies ONLY original face, hair and clothing identity; ignore all its pose, hands, legs, and drawn arrow.  image 3 is the primary approved painterly style. Exactly two legs and two arms. Green/ivory/gold outfit and boots. LEFT hand holds full bamboo longbow, no nocked arrow. Quiver at RIGHT shoulder. Full figure, same framing, safe margins, true transparent alpha, native single square image at least 1024x1024. No text, no grid, no mirror or copied pose. WEST screenLEFT facing. Keep the LARGE NEAR LEFT thigh/shin planted and straight exactly as reference, its boot beneath hips. Change the SMALL FAR RIGHT leg only: swing its knee forward so knee is hidden BEHIND the planted near thigh, and its boot comes forward to peek just to screenLEFT of supporting shin, slightly elevated. The crossing leg remains behind, never redraw it in foreground. New frame just after midpassing. No high knee.
